question: What claim about the range of languages arises from the distinction between heard and unheard forms in this context?
premises: Languages take on varied forms in this setting.
Some of those forms are heard while others are unheard.
Both classes of forms fall under the languages in question.
inference: The languages present include both heard and unheard forms of varied kinds.
uncertainties: It is not specified whether all varied forms fall into one of these two classes.
